anya: Draft PRD up for a progressive traffic-splitting rollout framework. Wanted input on acceptance criteria, pinning rules, and rollback triggers. doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/prd/prog-rollouts

anya: TL;DR acceptance criteria — latency p95 <= baseline * 1.2, error-rate increase <0.5pp and <2x baseline, quality regression <1% on canary prompt set. Default increments [1,5,20,50,100] with hold windows. Version pin: top-10 tenants pinned for 24h by default. Rollback triggers: p95 > 1.5x baseline for 5m OR error_rate > 2x baseline OR eval regression >1.5% confirmed by sampling. Need eng + data + SRE review :eyes:

mike: quick thoughts — increments look fine but 30m hold for 20->50 seems short if caches are cold. suggest hold windows [30m,60m,60m,30m] for [1,5,20,50,100] steps. we should auto-warm KV cache before increasing >5% and have a kill-switch endpoint (POST /rollouts/:id/kill). who owns canary prompt set? also need tenant pin bookkeeping (audit log). :mechanical_arm:

oliver: metrics proposal: track p50/p95/p99 latency, error_rate (5xx + handler errors), user_facing_failure_rate (fallbacks), and quality_delta from eval harness (3k prompt baseline). suggest SPRT with alpha=0.05 beta=0.2 for early stopping on quality. also want sampled request payloads (1% sample) streamed to kafka topic rollouts.sampled for offline checks.

sarah: SRE checklist items — require circuit-breaker with manual override in console, automatic rollback when p95 > baseline * 1.5 sustained for 5m (and traffic >20% for 10m), and pager if error_rate spike >2x baseline. need trace-id correlation in logs and a dashboard widget showing golden prompts. rollout-bot must post start/stop events and write audit entries to the compliance log. :rotating_light:

mike: example config I sketched for the service side:
```yaml
experiment:
  name: progressive-rollout-v0.3
  increments: [1, 5, 20, 50, 100]
  hold_minutes: [30, 60, 60, 30]
  kv_warmup: true
  rollback_thresholds:
    p95_multiplier: 1.5
    error_rate_multiplier: 2.0
  pin_top_tenants: 10
```

rollout-bot: experiment started by anya: progressive-rollout-v0.3 -> increments [1,5,20,50,100], hold windows [30m,60m,60m,30m], canary_group: beta-100. console: https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/exp-2534

anya: thanks — mike can you sketch the API surface + kill-switch by EOD? oliver can you produce baseline numbers for last 30d by EOD? sarah will add runbook snippets and alert thresholds. I'll update PRD with the changes and re-tag eng for grooming.

mike: yep — will add API doc + example curl for kill switch. Q: how do we treat noisy quality signals? propose an extra hold at 20% for 24h if quality metric variance > threshold.

oliver: copying baseline numbers into GDrive (tables + 30d baselines + sig tests) — https://drive.redwood/rollouts/baselines_v0.3

sarah: added runbook gist + pager flows: https://gist.github.com/redwood/runbook-prog-rollout. also created alert runbook card in ops board.

anya: perfect. action items: mike (API + kill-switch doc), oliver (baseline + SPRT config), sarah (runbook + alerts), anya (update PRD + schedule grooming). aiming for dev kickoff Mon. tagging @eng for visibility. :rocket:
